other.content: Inscribed in artist's handwriting on stretcher bar: 1/16/53 1/2 zinc 1/2 lead [according to Barbara Buhler Lynes, this refers to the recipe O'Keeffe used for the ground layer]; Label: American Painting of the Last 25 Years / Georgia O'Keeffe / Patio With Cloud / oil, 1956 / Lent by the Milwaukee Art center; Los Angeles County Museum / Exposition Park / Los Angeles 7 / California; The Downtown Gallery / 32 E. 51st St. / New York; stamp: Dogano di Napoli (Source: MAM, 2025)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] By October 9, 1956, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] December 14, 1957, purchased by Mrs. Edward R. (Ethel E.) Wehr [1885–1961] (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [3] December 19, 1957, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] Downtown Gallery, 31st Annual Exhibition (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1956), cat. 2. 
[2] Invoice addressed to Mrs. Edward R. Wehr in MAM object file, with canceled check dated February 14, 1959. MAM catalogue card also states that John Marin Jr., son of artist John Marin, but according to corresponce between registrar and catalogue raisonne researcher Barbara Buhler Lynes in January/February 1994, this is incorrect; Lynes found no records to indicate that Wehr was not the first owner, and registrar thinks that this is a mix-up with the Marin watercolor that Wehr also gave to the museum (M1957.19). See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 812, cat. 1291. 
[3] MAM catalogue card. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 812, cat. 1291. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
